$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Unique attack id, e.g. "forgotten-overhead-chop". Stable once shipped.

schemaVersion.description: AttackDef schema version, for future migrations.

notes.description: Where the numbers come from (bead, design intent), for owner review.

move.description: The move it performs: windup (startup), active and recovery ticks, hit volume, damage template, parry/block flags, telegraph tick and cues. Must be an "attack" move.

telegraph.description: Telegraph cue id render and audio play when the windup reads (TelegraphStarted event, mw-e04.20), e.g. "guard-strike-windup"; placeholder cues can be swapped later.

min.description: Closest distance to the target it is used from, metres.

max.description: Farthest distance to the target it is used from, metres; at least min.

range.description: Distance band to the target (centre to centre, metres) the attack is used from: the distance precondition, and what AI spacing (e11) aims for.

extraPackets.description: Damage packets applied per hit after the move’s own damage template (e.g. a separate poison packet); each goes through the damage model on its own.

amounts.description: Damage points per damage type (before resistances); unlisted types deal 0.

staminaDamage.description: Stamina drained from a blocker, in points (before shield stability).

impulse.description: Knockback impulse, N·s, in the attacker’s frame (+z forward, +y up).

tags.description: Damage-packet tags every hit carries, e.g. "critical" (damage model tags).

items.description: Damage packet template: what each hit applies through the damage model. Required with a hitbox.

cooldown.description: Seconds after it starts before it may start again.

weight.description: Relative selection weight among usable attacks (AI, e11).

preconditions.description: When the attack may be started, besides range and cooldown; evaluated deterministically by the sim (canStartAttack).

targetStances.description: Target stances it may be used against; absent = any.

health.description: Own health band (current / max health) it may be used in, e.g. a desperation move.

max.description: Highest own health fraction, 0–1; at least min.

speed.description: Flight speed, metres per second (straight line).

maxRange.description: Distance after which it vanishes, metres.

projectile.description: Projectile flight (required for kind "projectile", forbidden otherwise). It launches on the first active tick from the move’s sphere hit volume, which is its size and launch point.
